div.p: Schoolchildren played an active part in the war effort, contributing to patriotic movements through the provision of comforts for soldiers and fundraisers. Events such as Wattle Day and Children's Flower Day specifically appealed and children proudly displayed commemorative badges that demonstrated their involvement.
